title: Quick Smoked Portuguese Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring smoked fish and a blend of spices, perfect for a hangover cure. This dish is low in calories and features kosher salt and a smoke-cold flavor profile.
instructions: Heat the kosher salt in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the smoked cod fish and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato, white wine, chicken broth, paprika, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Use a thermometer to ensure the stew reaches a safe internal temperature of 165 degrees.
Let the stew cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread for a filling meal.
